workload.note: 260/384 comp, 20 pass TD, 15 INT (PFR passing table + StatMuse INT confirmation); released by Miami after 2025 season

contract.note: One-year, $1.3M deal with Atlanta; Miami still owes him $54M guaranteed for 2026 (CBS Sports)

scheme.note: New HC Kevin Stefanski (hired Jan 17, 2026, ex-Browns) and OC Tommy Rees (ex-Browns) both emphasize a quick-game, TE-heavy scheme with bootlegs/flat routes

competition.name: Michael Penix Jr.
competition.note: Incumbent Falcons QB; Stefanski has created 'a genuine competition' per CBS Sports; Penix tore ACL in November 2025, limited to individual/7-on-7 drills as of Aug 5, 2026, possible clearance ~4 weeks out

notes: Falcons signed Tua on a 1-year deal March 9, 2026 after Miami released him; explicitly to create a QB battle with Penix per ESPN/CBS reporting
Cooper Rush and UDFA Jack Strand were taking early first-team camp reps while both Tua and Penix were out (NFL.com)

camp.quote: I view it as a competition... It's definitely a competition.
Nothing too serious, just a caution kind of thing where we're not rushing it... We'll be fine.
